slides.title: A first word
slides.transcript: [warmly] Bismillah. A first word, for Yusuf. <break time="0.5s" /> [gently] The word we say before everything. Say it with me.

slides.title: When You Wake
slides.transcript: [warmly] When You Wake. <break time="0.4s" /> The light comes in at the window. You open your eyes, and the whole day is still in front of you. <break time="0.5s" /> [softly] Bismillah.

slides.title: Clean Hands
slides.transcript: [warmly] Clean Hands. <break time="0.4s" /> Cool water runs over your fingers, and over mine. Wash them well, little one. <break time="0.5s" /> [softly] Bismillah.

slides.title: Before You Eat
slides.transcript: [warmly] Before You Eat. <break time="0.4s" /> Warm bread. Sweet dates. A small bowl that is yours and nobody else's. <break time="0.5s" /> [softly] Bismillah.

slides.title: A Drink of Water
slides.transcript: [warmly] A Drink of Water. <break time="0.4s" /> Small sips, and a rest in between. Nothing in the world is better than water when you are thirsty. <break time="0.5s" /> [softly] Bismillah.

slides.title: Out the Door
slides.transcript: [warmly] Out the Door. <break time="0.4s" /> Little shoes on. The door swings open. The air outside smells like morning. <break time="0.5s" /> [softly] Bismillah.

slides.title: Home Again
slides.transcript: [warmly] Home Again. <break time="0.4s" /> Back through the same door, into the same warm room, where everyone was waiting for you. <break time="0.5s" /> [softly] Bismillah.

slides.title: Susu's Bowl
slides.transcript: [warmly] Susu's Bowl. <break time="0.4s" /> You fill the bowl, and the cat comes running. A small kindness is still a kindness. <break time="0.5s" /> [softly] Bismillah.

slides.title: Time to Sleep
slides.transcript: [warmly] Time to Sleep. <break time="0.4s" /> The lamp goes low. The blanket comes up. Your eyes are closing already, and that is allowed. <break time="0.5s" /> [softly] Bismillah.

slides.title: Goodnight
slides.transcript: [softly] Goodnight. <break time="0.4s" /> Every day begins with one word, and every day ends with it too. <break time="0.5s" /> [whispers] Bismillah. Goodnight, Yusuf.
